code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    sixes = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 6]
    segments = []
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2, c2 in ones[i + 1:]:
            dr, dc = r2 - r1, c2 - c1
            if abs(dr) == abs(dc):
                sr = 1 if dr > 0 else -1
                sc = 1 if dc > 0 else -1
                cells = [(r1 + k * sr, c1 + k * sc) for k in range(abs(dr) + 1)]
                segments.append((cells, sr == sc))
                for r, c in cells:
                    out[r][c] = 1
    for r6, c6 in sixes:
        for cells, is_down_right in segments:
            if (r6, c6) in cells:
                # The six marker sends a line along the other diagonal.
                if is_down_right:
                    coords = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r + c == r6 + c6]
                else:
                    coords = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r - c == r6 - c6]
                for r, c in coords:
                    out[r][c] = 6
                break
    return out
'''
